name: City Council Special Meeting of June 11, 2024
minutes_text:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  EL MONTE CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING
  OF JUNE 11, 2024

MEETING JOINTLY AND REGULARLY WITH THE EL MONTE HOUSING AUTHORITY; EL
MONTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY; EL MONTE PARKING AUTHORITY; EL MONTE
WATER AUTHORITY; SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE FORMER EL MONTE COMMUNITY
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY; HOUSING SUCCESSOR AGENCY; AND, FROM TIME TO
TIME, SUCH OTHER BODIES OF THE CITY WHOSE MEMBERSHIP IS COMPOSED
EXCLUSIVELY OF THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE CITY COUNCIL

1.  CALL TO ORDER: 6:01 p.m.

2.  ROLL CALL FOR CITY COUNCIL AND AUTHORITY BODIES:

  Jessica Ancona, Mayor/Chair – present
  Dr. Julia Ruedas, Mayor Pro Tem/Authority Member – present
  Marisol Cortez, Councilmember/Authority Member – present
  Martin Herrera, Councilmember/Authority Member – present
  Victoria Martinez Muela, Councilmember/Authority Member – present
  Alma D. Puente, Councilmember/Authority Member – present
  Richard Rojo, Councilmember/Authority Member – present

3.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

  WITH THE FOLLOWING EDITS/CHANGES TO THE AGENDA:

  WALK-ON ITEM:

  11.  CITY MANAGER’S AGENDA:

  11.1  Discussion Regarding the Appointment to the Metro San Gabriel
  Valley Service Council.

  m) Councilmember Puente
  s) Mayor Pro Tem Dr. Ruedas  7-0

4.  CLOSED SESSION:

  This is the time set aside for interested members of the public to address the City Council
  on agendized Closed Session matters. Subject to the commenting procedures described,
  above, the City Council will allow interested members of the public to address the City
  Council on agendized Closed Session matters prior to holding Closed Session. Each
  speaker will be given a single speaker time allotment of three (3) continuous minutes total
  to address the Council on any or all closed session items of business. The City Council
  shall be under no obligation to recognize a speaker who submits a speaker card after the
  City Council has gone into Closed Session.
  Wyatt Reneer – Spoke about the ceremony today for the Life Saving Award to Police
  Department Officers and Dispatchers. Also spoke about Closed Session Item 4.2.

  Mayor Ancona invited members of the public to address the City Council on Closed
  Session Items 4.1 and 4.2.

  Mayor Ancona and the City Council recessed into Closed Session at approximately
  6:05 p.m.  Mayor Ancona and the City Council reconvened from Closed Session
  at approximately 7:08 p.m.

  4.1  Closed Session Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9 Subparts (d)(2) –
  Conference with Legal Counsel – Anticipated Litigation – One (1) Matter.

  The City Council did not consider this item in Closed Session.
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

  4.2  Closed Session Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6 – Conference with
  Labor Negotiators.

  Bargaining Units Subject to Negotiations: El Monte General Unit (SEIU Local
  721); El Monte General Mid-Management Unit (SEIU Local 721); El Monte Police
  Officers Association; and El Monte Police Mid-Manager’s Association.

  City’s Designated Negotiator:  Alma Martinez, City Manager; and Rigoberto
  Gutierrez, Human Resources/Risk Management Director

  City Council received report from staff direction was given on a 5-2 vote
  (Mayor Ancona and City Councilmember Martinez Muela No), there is no final
  action to report.

5.  INVOCATION:  Chaplain. Mayor Ancona

6.  FLAG SALUTE:  Jamie Love Andrade, 6th Grade Student from Parkview School.
  Present

7.  RECOGNITIONS, HONORS AND COMMUNITY INTEREST PRESENTATIONS:

  7.1  Presentation by the City Council to Jamie Love Andrade from Parkview School for
  Leading the Pledge of Allegiance. Present

  7.2  Presentation by the City Council of the Life Saving Award to El Monte Police
  Dispatcher Sandra Gonzalez; El Monte Police Dispatch Shift Supervisor Veronica
  Chacon; El Monte Police Corporal Carlos Tello; and El Monte Police Officers
  Dennis Chiu and Raul Vega. Present

Break at 7:40 p.m.
Return at 7:56 p.m.

8.  PUBLIC COMMENT ON AGENDIZED, NON-PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS ONLY.

  This time has been set aside for members of the public to directly address the City Council
  on agendized items of business only (other than those items agendized as public hearing
  matters). Each speaker/caller will be limited to a single allotment of three (3) continuous
  minutes total to address the City Council on those agendized matters covered by this
  section. As explained more specifically under the Public Hearing portion of this agenda,
  members of the public wishing to offer comment on items of business agendized under
  the Public Hearing portion of the agenda shall have a separate allotment of three (3)
  continuous minutes per speaker per public hearing item. Except as otherwise provided
  under the Brown Act (Gov. Code Section 54950 et seq.), the Council may not deliberate
  or take action upon any matter not listed on this posted agenda. Persons wishing to
  address the Council on matters covered under General Public Comment shall call in or
  submit a speaker card in the manner prescribed on page 1 of this agenda, above, by or
  before the General Public Comment portion of the agenda is closed. The City Council
  shall be under no obligation to entertain comments from speakers/callers who submit
  cards or call in to speak on matters covered by the section after the General Public
  Comment portion of the agenda is closed.

  Richard Thomas – Spoke about Item 9.4 on the agenda.

  Juli Ramirez – Issues taking place at the parking lot at City Hall. Also spoke about the
  budget.

  Cosme Jimenez – Spoke about various budget line items. Also spoke about the ARPA
  budget.
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

9.  CONSENT CALENDAR:

  All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and
  may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One
  or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that they may be discussed,
  considered, and voted upon individually by the Council. A matter may be removed from
  the Consent Calendar and taken up separately by way of a seconded motion of any
  member of the Council with the approval of a majority of the Council quorum.

  9.1  Waiver of Full Reading of Ordinance(s).

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Approval to waive full reading (except title) of all ordinances appearing on the
  City Council agenda as authorized under Government Code Section 36934,
  unless otherwise directed by the City Council.

  Total Cost: N/A  Account No:  N/A
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? N/A

  m) Councilmember Herrera
  s) Councilmember Puente  7-0

  9.2  Consideration and Approval of a Second Amendment to the Professional Services
  Agreement for Raftelis to Provide Technical and Preparation Continuation of
  Services for the Sewer Rate Study.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Consider and approve a Second Amendment to the Professional Services
  Agreement to Raftelis to provide technical and preparation continuation
  services for the Sewer Rate Study and add an additional $30,000 to the
  existing agreement amount of $100,068.10, bringing the total Agreement
  amount to a not-to-exceed amount of $130,068.10 for additional services
  needed; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute the Second
  Amendment Agreement with Raftelis.

  Total Cost: $30,000  Account No:  650-67-693-6111
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? Yes  Sewer Fund Account

  m) Mayor Ancona
  s) Councilmember Martinez Muela  7-0

  9.3  Consideration and Adoption of a Resolution Approving the Annual Adjustment for
  Inflation for User and Regulatory Fees Set by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
  Consumer Price Index for the Los Angeles Area.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Adopt the Resolution approving the annual adjustment for inflation for User and
  Regulatory Fees set by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price
  Index for the Los Angeles area; and
  2. Direct staff to update the User Fees and Development Impact Fees which shall
  take effect and be implemented on July 1, 2024.
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

  Total Cost: N/A  Account No:  N/A
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? N/A

  Resolution No. 10546

  m) Councilmember Herrera
  s) Councilmember Puente  7-0

  9.4  Consideration and Adoption of a Resolution Approving the Fiscal Year 2024-2025
  Estimated Sewer Fund Proceeds Reimbursement Sum to the General Fund, and
  When the Actual Allowable Reimbursement Sum Can be Calculated, Directing the
  Return of Any Sums in Excess of What is Allowable for Reimbursement Pursuant
  to Section 3.01.100(C) of the El Monte Municipal Code, if any, by or Before the
  End of Fiscal Year 2024-2025.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Adopt the Resolution approving the Fiscal Year 2024-2025 Estimated Sewer
  Fund Proceeds Reimbursement Sum to the General Fund, and when the
  Actual Allowable Reimbursement Sum can be Calculated, Directing the Return
  of any Sums in Excess of What is Allowable for Reimbursement Pursuant to
  Section 3.01.100(C) of the El Monte Municipal Code, if any, by or Before the
  End of Fiscal Year 2024-2025.

  Total Cost: N/A  Account No:  N/A
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? N/A

  Resolution No. 10549

  m) Mayor Ancona
  s) Councilmember Martinez Muela  7-0
  To table item

Break at 9:20 p.m.
Return at 9:30 p.m.

At 9:30 p.m.
m) Councilmember Martinez Muela
s) Mayor Ancona
Extend the meeting past 10:00 p.m.

10.  REGULAR AGENDA:

  10.1  Consideration and Adoption of the Comprehensive Budget for Fiscal Year
  2024/2025 by Resolution.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Consider and adopt a Resolution approving FY 2024/2025 Comprehensive
  Annual Operating Budget totaling $295.5 million, which includes: $97.3 million
  General Fund Budget; $24.1 million Enterprise Fund (Water and Sewer)
  Budget; and $174.1 million Special Revenue Funds and Other Funds Budget;
  and
  2. Consider and adopt a Resolution approving the Fiscal Year 2024/2025 Water
  Budget totaling $11,634,624.

  Total Cost: N/A  Account No:  N/A
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? N/A
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

  Resolution No. 10547
  Resolution No. EMWA-38

  m) Councilmember Puente
  s) Councilmember Herrera  5-2 (Mayor Ancona and Councilmember
  Adding staff’s additions  Martinez Muela No)
  to the Parks and Recreation
  Programming

10.2  Consideration and Approval of a Contract Services Agreement with ATI
  Restoration, Inc. to Complete Mold Remediation and Lead-Based Paint Abatement
  in the Community Center Kitchen for a Not-to-Exceed Amount of $66,252.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Consider and approve a Contract Services Agreement with ATI Restoration,
  Inc. to complete mold remediation and lead-based paint abatement in the
  Community Center Kitchen; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute a Contract Services
  Agreement with ATI Restoration, Inc.

  Total Cost: $66,252  Account No:  100-67-673-6111
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? No

  m) Councilmember Martinez Muela
  s) Mayor Pro Tem Dr. Ruedas  7-0

10.3  Consideration and Approval of a Resolution Adopted Per El Monte Municipal Code
  Section 3.24.060(F) to Approve a Contract Services Agreement with Nationwide
  Environmental Services a Division of Joe’s Sweeping Inc. to Perform Transit Stop
  Cleaning and Maintenance Services for a Term of Three (3) Years with an Option
  for Two (2) One-Year Extension Terms.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. By 4/5 vote of the City Council, approve the attached Resolution approving
  pursuant to El Monte Municipal Code Section 3.24.060(F) a Contract Services
  Agreement with Nationwide Environmental Services, a Division of Joe’s
  Sweeping Inc. to perform transit stop cleaning and maintenance services for a
  term of three (3) years with the option for two (2), one-year extension terms.
  Compensation Terms: Year One (1) Contract Price: $199,800; Year Two (2)
  Contract Price: $207,792; Year Three (3) Contract Price: $216,104; Optional
  Extension Term One (1) Contract Price: $224,748; and Optional Extension
  Term Two (2) Contract Price: $233,738.

  Total Cost: $1,082,182  Account No:  203-67-579-6111
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? Yes

  Resolution No. 10548

  m) Councilmember Herrera
  s) Councilmember Cortez  6-1 (Councilmember Martinez Muela No)
  Include Prevailing Wages which
  Will add an additional $5,000 per month
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

  10.4  Consideration and Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with the Law
  Firm of JL Group LLC for Continued Special Counsel for Litigation, Internal Affairs
  Investigations, and Pre-Employment Background Inquiries.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Consider and approve a Professional Services Agreement with the Law Firm
  of JL Group, LLC; the use of General Funds from Account No. 100-71-711-
  6125, in an amount not-to-exceed $100,000.00 for expenditures related to
  independent internal affairs investigations, legal counsel, and pre-employment
  background inquiries associated with potential workplace misconduct and
  police employee recruitment.

  Total Cost: $100,000  Account No:  100-71-711-6125
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? Yes

  m) Mayor Ancona
  s) Councilmember Herrera  7-0

  10.5  Consideration and Approval of a Professional Services Agreement with HdL
  Companies for the Preparation of an Economic Development Strategic Plan to
  Guide the City of El Monte’s Economic Development Priorities and Programs.

  RECOMMENDATION OF BUSINESS ITEM UNDER CONSIDERATION:

  It is recommended that the City Council:

  1. Approve the Professional Services Agreement with HdL Companies for the
  preparation of an Economic Development Strategic Plan to guide the City of El
  Monte’s Economic Development priorities and programs, for an amount of
  $148,650 plus a 20% contingency, for a total not-to-exceed amount of
  $178,380; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute all documents related
  to the Professional Services Agreement.

  Total Cost: $178,380  Account No:  100-61-617-6111
  Is the cost of this item budgeted? Yes

  m) Mayor Ancona
  s) Councilmember Herrera  7-0

11.  CITY MANAGER’S AGENDA:

  11.1  Discussion Regarding the Appointment to the Metro San Gabriel Valley Service
  Council.

  m) Mayor Ancona
  s) Councilmember Martinez Muela
  Support the Nomination of Councilmember Ed Chen to the Metro San Gabriel
  Valley Services Council.
   City Council Special Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2024

12.  ADJOURNMENT:

  11:27 p.m.
  m) Mayro Ancona
  s) Councilmember Puente
  Adjourn the meeting

  The next Regular Meeting of the City Council will be held on July 2, 2024 at 6:00 p.m.
  This Agenda will be posted on the City’s website, www.ci.el-monte.ca.us, and physically
  posted no less than 72 hours prior to the start of the subject regular meeting. Although it
  is the City’s practice and desire to electronically post a copy of this Agenda along with
  supporting material as part of its website posting, the size or formatting of certain
  supporting materials may render their website posting infeasible. Nevertheless, all
  supporting materials related to any item on this Agenda, that is made available to the
  members of the council may be inspected by members of the public at the City Clerk’s
  Office located at 11333 Valley Boulevard, El Monte, Monday through Thursday, 7:00 am
  – 5:30 pm. For more information, please call the City Clerk’s Office at 626-580-2016.

  All public meetings and events sponsored or conducted by the City of El Monte are held
  in sites accessible to persons with disabilities. Requests for accommodations may be
  made by calling the office of the City Clerk at (626) 580-2016 at least three (3) working
  days prior to the event, if possible. This Agenda and copies of documents distributed at
  the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request.

  Gabriel Ramirez, City Clerk
  City of El Monte
